title: Show how groups overlap
description: A Venn diagram draws two or three circles whose areas are the sizes of the sets, with their overlaps at their own sizes.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]

## Three channels and the readers they share

These illustrative counts give each channel its readers, and each overlap the readers it has in common. A row names the sets it counts, joined by an ampersand: a single set is its total, and two or three sets are the size of their overlap.

```chart
type: venn
title: Web and email readers overlap the most
subtitle: Readers by channel, a row for each set and each overlap, illustrative counts
data:
  inline:
    - {channel: Email, readers: 620}
    - {channel: App, readers: 480}
    - {channel: Web, readers: 540}
    - {channel: "Email & App", readers: 180}
    - {channel: "Email & Web", readers: 210}
    - {channel: "App & Web", readers: 150}
    - {channel: "Email & App & Web", readers: 70}
encoding: {sets: channel, y: readers}
axes:
  y: {label: Readers}
```

*Source: Illustrative counts.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each channel and each overlap.
